featured_reviews.name: Sagar Pawar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Went to Xinji Oriental Cuisine recently and had a really good time. The staff was very warm and polite, just genuinely nice and helpful. They explained the dishes properly and helped us pick, which was appreciated.

Food was solid.
Chicken Fried Rice – 5/5, very well cooked and full of flavour.
Hunan Chicken Gravy – 4/5, tasty and nicely balanced.
Teriyaki Chicken Bao – 5/5, easily the best thing we had. Soft, juicy and properly done (must try).

Everything we ordered had a good balance in taste nothing too spicy, not too bland, and not oily either. You can tell they focus on getting the flavours right.

The place itself is calm and cozy, perfect for a relaxed dinner. Also looks nice if you’re into clicking photos.

Price is fair for what they serve good portions, good quality, and overall it feels worth it 100%.

Overall, ek number place. Would definitely go again with friends or family 👍

featured_reviews.review_text:
I rarely give 5 stars, but this restaurant truly deserves it.
It is tucked quitely in a corner surrounded by residential area of Mulund east.
It has a good ambience and the staff are polite and helpful.
But, the food is the star. The restaurant has managed to maintain the authenticity of the cuisines at the same time tuned them to the palette of the customers.
All that at an affordable price.
If you want a mainland china experience which is easy on the pocket, this is the place for you.
Note, there is no valet parking.

featured_reviews.name: Fat Tummiess
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an amazing experience at Xinji — truly a hidden gem in Mulund! 🌸✨
A cute and cozy Pan-Asian spot that Mulund really needed. The place is aesthetic, affordable, and perfect for a chill outing with friends or family. The quality, presentation, and quantity of food were all on point!

Here’s what we tried:

• Spicy Crab Meat Soup – Rich, flavourful, and perfectly spiced. A great start to the meal with a comforting yet bold taste.

• Manchow Soup – Classic but done really well, with a nice balance of spice and crunch. Very satisfying!

• Prawns Singapore Chilli Dry – Packed with flavour and perfectly cooked prawns. Spicy, tangy, and super addictive.

• Stir Fried Sriracha Fish – Soft fish tossed in a spicy sriracha glaze, giving it a nice kick and delicious flavour.

• Veg Manchurian – Not your usual one! Had a unique oriental twist that made it stand out and taste amazing.

• Teriyaki Chicken Sushi – Just WOW! 🍣 Perfectly rolled, fresh, and bursting with flavour — definitely a must-try.

• Chicken Triple Rice – Looks like a regular dish but tastes way better here. Great quality and very fulfilling.

• Chicken Chilli Garlic Noodles – Super flavourful with the right amount of spice and garlic. Loved the texture and taste.

⸻

Overall, everything tasted amazing — from quality to presentation, everything was just perfect. Definitely visiting again! 💯✨

featured_reviews.review_text: Heard lot about "ranjeet" so it was always in list & finally got a chance because it was holy "Shravan" month, so went for Pure Veg Chinese but had terrible experience. Crowd was there but very bad management. Paaji was extreme busy at cashier. leakage inside of hotel due to rain for one table. Only two guys was serving but those two "ambaanis" was not at all listening us. For every 5-7 times he listened once. Water glass i got at my last dish despite asking 10 times. Instead of noodles he gave me rice. I had to eat because he was requesting me that it will take lot of time. No spoons no plates given we had to use one single plate & soup spoons to eat. I asked for chutney for almost 6-7 times he did not have even once. We started with 3 different soups in which one was "special ranjeet soup", manchow & Schezwan soup, trust me all three was same just different colour. Nothing different inside he lied about veggies but I literally giveup to complain. Now about taste, so i am die hard chinese cuisine lover & i even know how to make it just like chef. Trust me you will find it's was tasted like just local Chinese. I will say local Chinese taste better. They served lot of varieties that's really good but if your main base "Schezwan" is not orignal then taste going to mess. I got to know about quality when he served "timepass" with chutney. I had hopes they might be using orignal schezwan in dishes but No. Only one good thing was quantity was good enough than other restaurants but rate was also on higher side for most dishes you cannot skip that part. I may not visit this restaurant again & won't recommend, i may give try again some other time if situation demands just for checking improvement. It's quite understandable that since it's pure veg & jain also available so you may expect crowd from vegans since it has no competition at all with any non-veg restaurant. I request owner to work on taste specially "schezwan" part which is most basic ingredient for almost all Chinese dishes & also lower your rate atleast by 10% & please have some more waiters. Sorry Paaji i had to write like this but wish you all the best & i hope in future i may see all together improvement. Tip : Try Mitran Da Dhabas management how one guy (waiter) easily handles atleast 10-15 tables & still no complaints from customers despite having lot of crowd. It just surprises me.

featured_reviews.name: Nikhil Aher
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ Kampa Chinese – A Hidden Gem for Mulund’s Chinese Food Lovers

Kampa Chinese is hands down one of the best hidden gems for Chinese food in Mulund. It’s the kind of place locals swear by—and for good reason.

The price-to-value ratio is outstanding. Portions are generous, pricing is extremely reasonable, and the quality consistently punches above its weight. Whether you’re ordering noodles, rice, gravies, or starters, every dish feels satisfying both in quantity and taste.

Despite being a small outlet, it’s almost always busy, which says a lot about its popularity among Mulundkars. The crowd is a mix of regulars and takeaway customers, clearly driven by word-of-mouth rather than hype.

A major highlight is customisation—each dish can be tailored based on spice levels and choice of meats, making it perfect for people who like their Indo-Chinese either mild, fiery, or anywhere in between. Flavours are bold, sauces are well-balanced, and nothing tastes generic or mass-produced.

This is not a fancy dine-in spot, but if you care about taste, quantity, and value, Kampa Chinese delivers consistently and confidently.

⭐ Rating: 5/5
A true Mulund favourite and a must-try for anyone craving reliable, flavour-packed Chinese food.

## Late Night Visit Experience – Fast Service but Poor Food Quality

⭐️⭐️☆☆☆ (2/5)

Recently visited China Garden Fast Food around 11:30 PM for a late-night meal.

### What I Liked

• Service was very quick despite the late-night timing.
• Staff handled the order efficiently and food was served fast.
• Convenient option if someone is looking for food late at night in Mulund.

### What Needs Improvement

• Food quality was not up to the mark considering the prices charged.
• The outlet feels expensive for a fast-food style Chinese restaurant.
• Taste and preparation lacked freshness and proper balance.
• The chicken lollipop was extremely oily and difficult to enjoy.
• Excessive oil completely affected the taste and overall experience.
• Portion-to-quality ratio did not justify the pricing.

### Major Concern

• Unfortunately, after eating here, I faced stomach discomfort and washroom issues for the next couple of days.
• Hygiene, oil quality, and food consistency seriously need improvement.

### Final Thoughts

The place definitely has potential because the service speed is impressive and the location works well for late-night customers. However, food quality and hygiene standards need major improvement before it can justify its pricing.

As someone who regularly reviews restaurants and food outlets, I feel this place can become much better with proper attention to food preparation and quality control. For now, it was a disappointing experience overall and not somewhere I would personally recommend.

featured_reviews.name: Swapnil Tamhankar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Bonsai The Chinese House in Thane is a fantastic destination for anyone who enjoys authentic Chinese and Pan-Asian cuisine. The restaurant boasts a cozy and vibrant ambiance with its tasteful décor, including elements of traditional Chinese design that make it feel inviting and aesthetically pleasing. The atmosphere is perfect for both casual dining with friends and family or for a more intimate evening out.

When it comes to the food, Bonsai doesn’t disappoint. The menu offers a wide variety of options, including soups, appetizers, noodles, and mains, all inspired by authentic Chinese flavors. Their dim sums and soups are particular favorites among patrons, consistently receiving high praise for their taste and presentation. The stir-fried dishes and noodles also stand out, with balanced flavors and fresh ingredients.

One of the key highlights is their prompt service. The staff is friendly, courteous, and knowledgeable about the menu, often helping diners pick dishes based on their preferences. Whether you’re a vegetarian or non-vegetarian, there’s something for everyone, and the chefs are accommodating when it comes to customizing spice levels or other specific requests.

That said, the portions can be slightly smaller than expected, and the prices are on the higher side compared to other local eateries. However, the quality and taste of the food justify the cost.

Located conveniently in Thane, Bonsai The Chinese House offers a dining experience that transports you straight to the heart of Chinese cuisine. It’s an ideal spot for a special dinner, a family outing, or just to indulge in delicious Asian flavors.

featured_reviews.name: Sayali Mhamunkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited this place today, and honestly, it’s getting worse with time. I had visited about a year ago and even then found a cockroach in the food. Still, I decided to give it another try today—but it turned out to be an even worse experience.

We ordered Butter Garlic Chicken and Chicken Pan Fried Noodles (₹600 total). The Butter Garlic Chicken had only 5–6 tiny pieces, the garlic wasn’t properly chopped, and it didn’t taste fresh at all. Somehow managed to eat it.

The Chicken Pan Fried Noodles were even more disappointing. Just by looking at it, we could tell it wasn’t the same dish as before when the restaurant had newly opened. We still confirmed with the waiter, and he insisted it was correct. But there was no chicken at all, the noodles were plain boiled with zero flavor—not even salt. They were overcooked, sticky, and mushy. The gravy was overly salty and sour, and the vegetables didn’t seem fresh.

We took one bite and had to throw it away. Total waste of money.

Also, they took 56 mins to serve a single dish and for noodles more 25 mins

Would not recommend at all—this place is not what it used to be.

featured_reviews.name: Niv Shetye
featured_reviews.review_text:
Bonsai, located in Wagle Estate, Thane, is a fast-food specialty restaurant that has become a go-to spot for Chinese cuisine, which we've recently grown fond of. As Chinese food is consistently at the top of my favorite fast food list, our quest for delicious and flavorful Chinese dishes led us to Bonsai.

The restaurant has a simple yet beautiful ambiance, complemented by polite staff with excellent knowledge of their menu. On the recommendation of our server, we decided to try the Chicken Turkish Roll for the starter and Chicken Heaven Rice for the main course.

The Chicken Turkish Roll was served first, featuring a mildly spicy gravy. The taste and texture were so satisfying that it left us wanting more—truly a super delicious dish. The Chicken Heaven Rice came with two gravies: one Schezwan gravy, which was tangy, and another creamy gravy that was well-balanced. The rice itself stood out with an excellent balance of flavors, cooked to perfection. Combined with the gravies, it was a match made in heaven.

Bonsai has now earned a spot among our favorite places to enjoy Chinese food, and its pocket-friendly pricing makes it even more appealing. We will definitely be visiting this restaurant again.
